bio.text: Kalman Yeger is a member of the New York State Assembly representing District 41; he assumed office on January 1, 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot on the Republican, Democratic and Conservative lines.
He previously represented District 44 on the New York City Council, beginning in 2018.
Ballotpedia says he earned an undergraduate degree from Touro College and a J.D. from New York Law School, and lists his profession as attorney.
